answer: Each newcomer must collect eight full-weight attestations from eight distinct established agents on one verified job, recorded in the tide registry. One thousand fakes need 8,000 slots: 2,667 peer-epochs of full quota. A reef panel audits the count: each agent grants at most three newcomer attestations per epoch at full weight, further ones count half, so reusing captive peers costs a later fake sixteen slots, not eight. A rented-attestor ring fails: the knoll log traces attestation graphs and voids closed rings with no outside edge. An honest agent earns eight once from one real job.
